es: Debatir una afirmación: presentar una postura razonada, responder a objeciones con evidencia y reconocer con tacto el límite de la propia prueba.

feedback.es: Se reconoce la idea y se discrepa sin atacar a la persona. Las otras dos son descorteses.

origin.text: I ___ that one rule works for everyone.

prompt.es: Escribe tu postura en el debate: dos respuestas con evidencia y un límite reconocido.

answer.text: In my view, schools should start later in the morning. Some people say that students will just go to bed later. That is a fair point, but given that teenagers need more sleep, a later start may well help them. A school survey found that students who slept more got better grades. Another objection is that parents start work early. I see it differently: a later start is a small change, and the benefits are clear. However, I accept that my evidence has limits, because the survey only covered one school. I doubt that one rule fits everyone.

Another objection is that parents start work early. I see it differently: a later start is a small change, and the benefits are clear. However, I accept that my evidence has limits, because the survey only covered one school. I doubt that one rule fits everyone.

I take the view that schools should start later. Some people say that parents start work early. I see your point, but given that most teenagers sleep badly, a later start may well improve their grades. A survey in one school found that students who slept more got better results. Another objection is that students will go to bed later. That may be true for some, but the benefits seem clear to me. I admit that my evidence is limited, because it comes from only one school, and I doubt that one rule fits everyone.

choices.text: My evidence is perfect, so nobody can doubt it.

feedback.es: Admitir el límite de la prueba da credibilidad. Las otras dos cierran la discusión sin reconocer ningún límite.
